doctrine: First-party prompt library. A prompt enters as a draft, earns its place through AutoPrompt calibration (measured score on a saved edge-case dataset), and is versioned immutably. Every promote/pull is logged in the hash-chained ledger.jsonl. Nothing ships uncalibrated; scores are bound to a model name and a dataset, never quoted bare.
